card.name: Linking words before place or group names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (between, in, from, the, a comma) that come just before a proper name, mostly a place or group in Eastern European, Russian or Central Asian history text. It also fires on commas inside a list of symptoms.

modes.label: Before place names
modes.description: A preposition or small word just before a Eastern European or Central Asian place or group name.

modes.label: Inside symptom lists
modes.description: A comma in the list of signs of a drug reaction, before the next sign.
